description: One delivery cycle: four feature slices, then the open bugs, then the full test suite, then the tech-debt cooldown and the user's approval. Bugs come first at every step: no feature slice starts while a bug bead is open. Start it with .agents/skills/plan-reviewable-epics/scripts/start-cycle.sh <cycle>.

steps.title: Cycle {{cycle}}: feature slice 1
steps.description: Bugs first: `bd list --type bug --status open` must be empty before the slice starts; fix each open bug in its own reviewed jj change (a bug fix is not a feature slice). When the user asks for the next slice, take the next one by epic order and `bd ready`, and start it with start-slice.sh. Write the slice into this step: `bd update <this step> --notes "<slice-bead> <ID>"`. Close this step when the slice bead closes.

steps.title: Cycle {{cycle}}: feature slice 2
steps.description: Same as feature slice 1: bugs first, then the next slice through start-slice.sh. Note the slice here and close this step when the slice bead closes.

steps.title: Cycle {{cycle}}: feature slice 3
steps.description: Same as feature slice 1: bugs first, then the next slice through start-slice.sh. Note the slice here and close this step when the slice bead closes.

steps.title: Cycle {{cycle}}: feature slice 4
steps.description: Same as feature slice 1: bugs first, then the next slice through start-slice.sh. Note the slice here and close this step when the slice bead closes.

steps.title: Cycle {{cycle}}: fix the open bugs
steps.description: Fix every open bug bead (`bd list --type bug --status open`), each in its own reviewed jj change. Close this step when none is open.

steps.title: Cycle {{cycle}}: run the full test suite
steps.description: Per change, only the touched section's UI tests ran (`mac-test --ui <Class>`). Now run everything: `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `devenv shell -- mac-test` with no --ui, and the iOS build-for-testing. File each failure as a bug bead and fix it, then run the whole suite again. Write the results into this step's notes and close it when everything passes.

steps.title: Cycle {{cycle}}: tech-debt cooldown
steps.description: Audit the codebase: correctness, API hygiene, performance, tests, naming, dependencies, migrations, tooling, security, each finding with file:line and severity. Push back on false findings. File the real ones as beads with the tech-debt label. Send the audit to an Inbox thread named "Cooldown {{cycle}}". Clear every open tech-debt bead (`bd list --label tech-debt --status open`), each in a reviewed jj change. Close this step when none is open.

steps.title: Cycle {{cycle}}: close the cycle
steps.description: Waits for the human gate: close it when the user approves the cooldown in the "Cooldown {{cycle}}" thread. Then close this step and the workflow root ("Cycle {{cycle}}"), and start the next cycle with start-cycle.sh <next number>.
